subject.title: fix(telegram): suppress reconnect drain re-entry while delivery is in-flight

question: Should the public Plugin SDK expose structured reconnect-drain result metadata for bundled and third-party plugins?
rationale: Telegram must use an SDK seam rather than core internals, but the permanent API shape and compatibility commitment require maintainer intent.

options.title: Add a sibling result API
options.body: Keep `drainPendingDeliveries` returning `Promise<void>` and add a narrow result-returning function for callers that need metadata.

options.title: Add a result callback
options.body: Keep the existing return type and add an optional callback to the options contract.

options.title: Accept the return change
options.body: Change the existing return type with explicit compatibility approval, documentation, and external contract coverage.

recommendation.title: Add a sibling result API
recommendation.body: Keep `drainPendingDeliveries` returning `Promise<void>` and add a narrow result-returning function for callers that need metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice governs the public Plugin SDK contract rather than Telegram-only implementation details.
